body.why: No recording carries a profile/llm/fetch_models reply or a PASSING profile/llm/test (r29a's only test was refused with a 401). These follow the web's types (packages/client/src/onboarding.ts LlmFetchModelsResult {profile_id, family_id, models[], reason}; LlmTestResult {profile_id, applied, message, error}) for the recorded Profile dsflash and its recorded deepseek routes (r2-profile: the primary on route deepseek, the fallback on r2-route). The list, the upsert and the delete replies are r2-profile's own recordings.
